SELECT id,LEAD(v,2,-99) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS literal,LEAD(v,1+1,-99) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS folded,LEAD(v,CAST(2 AS INT),-99) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS cast_offset FROM inputs
SELECT id,LAG(v,2,-99) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS literal,LAG(v,1+1,-99) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS folded,LAG(v,CAST(2 AS INT),-99) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS cast_offset FROM inputs

SELECT id,LEAD(v,2) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 FOLLOWING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS literal,LEAD(v,CAST(2 AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN CAST(2 AS INT) FOLLOWING AND CAST(2 AS INT) FOLLOWING) AS cast_offset FROM inputs
SELECT id,LEAD(v,2) OVER w AS first_copy,LEAD(v,2) OVER w AS second_copy,LEAD(v,1+1) OVER w AS folded FROM inputs WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY id)

SELECT id,SUM(v) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS literal,SUM(v) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN (1+1) PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS folded,SUM(v) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS different FROM inputs
SELECT id,literal,folded,literal+folded AS combined FROM (SELECT id,LEAD(v,2) OVER w AS literal,LEAD(v,1+1) OVER w AS folded FROM inputs WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY id)) q WHERE id>1 ORDER BY folded,id
SELECT g,SUM(v) AS total,LEAD(SUM(v),2) OVER (ORDER BY g) AS literal,LEAD(SUM(v),1+1) OVER (ORDER BY g) AS folded FROM inputs GROUP BY g
